# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records from the supplied invented corpus (fixture-001.json)
- Reports a learner recall outcome

## Exclusion criteria
- Records outside the supplied fixture
- No recall outcome reported
